whenToUse: Photos are the focus, as in galleries, products, or article images.
The layout and mood should come first even on slow networks.
The server can deliver a small preview alongside.
whenNotToUse: Small images such as icons or logos.
Right after a user upload, when no preview can be made.
Images where exact content matters (they might be misread while blurred).

alternatives.name: Skeleton
alternatives.reason: Reserving space for content beyond images too.

accessibility: The blurred preview is decorative, so it's alt="" and aria-hidden; only the original image has alt text.
Reserve the final ratio from the start so the layout doesn't shift when the image arrives (CLS).
The sharpening transition happens instantly under reduced motion.
Cached images may finish before onLoad, so check the complete value too.
